d: A figure of athletic build wearing a full set of polished silver plate armor over a slate-blue fabric undersuit. The ensemble includes a closed knight's helm with a slitted visor, heavy pauldrons, a breastplate, and articulated greaves, all accented by a gold-colored belt and a large heater shield with a gold border. The face is entirely concealed by the helmet, and no hair or skin is visible. The character is equipped with a sword held in the right hand and a shield in the left.
